units.source_text: 換句話說，我迄今為止的恐懼感，很大成分帶有「科學迷信」的杞人憂天，就好像擔心春風裡有數十萬的百日咳細菌；

en.t: In other words, my fear up to now was largely a groundless anxiety tinged with scientific superstition, as if I worried that hundreds of thousands of whooping cough bacteria were in the spring wind;

units.source_text: 澡堂裡有數十萬致人失明的真菌；

en.t: that in the bathhouse there were hundreds of thousands of fungi that could blind people;

units.source_text: 理髮店裡有數十萬禿頭病菌；

en.t: that in the barber shop there were hundreds of thousands of germs that caused baldness;

units.source_text: 省線電車裡的吊環上爬動著無數疥癬蟲；

en.t: that countless scabies mites were crawling on the hanging straps in the government-line trains;

units.source_text: 生魚片和烤得半生的豬牛肉裡，潛伏著絛蟲和吸蟲的幼蟲什麼的；

en.t: that larvae of tapeworms, flukes, and the like were lurking in sashimi and half-cooked pork and beef;

units.source_text: 還擔心光腳走路時，扎破腳掌的碎玻璃會鑽進體內，

en.t: and I even worried that, when I walked barefoot, broken glass piercing the sole of my foot would enter my body,

units.source_text: 因迴圈全身戳破眼珠而導致失明，等等。

en.t: circulate through my whole body, pierce my eyeballs, and make me go blind, and so on.

units.source_text: 的確，站在「科學」的觀點，數十萬細菌在蠕動也許是能成立的。

en.t: Indeed, from a scientific point of view, it may be true that hundreds of thousands of bacteria are writhing there.
